body: The useful question about a smart classroom is not whether a school has one. It is whether a teacher can **assume** it.
Alongside them it runs **two computer laboratories**, junior and senior, carrying **40+ machines each**.

sys.heading:
Four numbers,
{{and one of them is a gap.}}
body: Read together the first two say something a marketing sentence would not: **the panels do not yet reach every room.** This is a rollout in progress rather than a finished one — and a school that publishes both numbers has already given a parent the means to work that out.

beyond.heading:
Technology is the tool.

The classroom
{{keeps changing.}}
body: The school publishes its room counts, its panel count and the certification behind them. It does not publish a device-per-child ratio, a rollout schedule for the remaining rooms, or which classes take digital literacy and for how long — so none of those is described here.
